title: Three Generations Guarded This Jar. Nobody Was Allowed to Open It.
description:
An old-quarter house is about to be sold to a hotel chain. In the storeroom, a polite little ghost keeps counting.
Told by the ma xo, the corner ghost who guards a family's wealth — whatever that wealth turns out to be.

A fictional story inspired by Vietnamese folklore about the ma xo — the corner ghost who guards a family's wealth. Characters and events are fictional. Voices and images were made with AI.

New episodes every few days. Subscribe @ThePettyGhost — a petty little house ghost tells you what the living get up to.
